label: prepare-host
argv:
python3 -c '"""Install only the operator-reviewed missing VM prerequisites, with exact deltas."""
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess

EXPECTED = set('"'"''"'"''"'"'libaio1 libbrlapi0.8 libcacard0 libcapstone4 libdaxctl1 libdrm-amdgpu1 libdrm-radeon1 libepoxy0 libexecs0 libwayland-server0 libxcb-randr0 libglapi-mesa libz3-4 libllvm15 libsensors-config libsensors5 libx11-xcb1 libxcb-dri2-0 libxcb-dri3-0 libxcb-present0 libxcb-sync1 libxcb-xfixes0 libxshmfence1 mesa-libgallium libgbm1 libgstreamer1.0-0 liborc-0.4-0 libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-0 libndctl6 libopus0 libpixman-1-0 libpmem1 libsndio7.0 libspice-server1 libusbredirparser1 libvdeplug2 qemu-efi-aarch64 qemu-system-common qemu-system-data qemu-system-arm qemu-utils'"'"''"'"''"'"'.split())
BASE = pathlib.Path.home() / '"'"'limeos-arm64-qual'"'"'
assert not BASE.exists(), '"'"'owned staging directory unexpectedly exists'"'"'
assert subprocess.check_output(['"'"'uname'"'"', '"'"'-m'"'"'], text=True).strip() == '"'"'aarch64'"'"'
assert pathlib.Path('"'"'/dev/kvm'"'"').is_char_device()
subprocess.run(['"'"'sudo'"'"', '"'"'-n'"'"', '"'"'true'"'"'], check=True)

def packages():
    text = subprocess.check_output(['"'"'dpkg-query'"'"', '"'"'-W'"'"', '"'"'-f=${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${db:Status-Abbrev}\n'"'"'], text=True)
    return text, {line.split('"'"'\t'"'"')[0]: line for line in text.splitlines()}

before, rows = packages()
manual_before = subprocess.check_output(['"'"'apt-mark'"'"', '"'"'showmanual'"'"'], text=True)
simulation = subprocess.check_output(['"'"'sudo'"'"', '"'"'-n'"'"', '"'"'apt-get'"'"', '"'"'-s'"'"', '"'"'--no-install-recommends'"'"', '"'"'--no-upgrade'"'"', '"'"'install'"'"', '"'"'qemu-system-arm'"'"', '"'"'qemu-efi-aarch64'"'"', '"'"'qemu-utils'"'"'], text=True)
planned = set(re.findall(r'"'"'^Inst ([^ ]+) '"'"', simulation, re.MULTILINE))
assert planned == EXPECTED, ('"'"'package set changed'"'"', sorted(planned ^ EXPECTED))
assert not re.search(r'"'"'^Remv '"'"', simulation, re.MULTILINE), '"'"'package removal proposed'"'"'
assert '"'"'0 upgraded, 41 newly installed, 0 to remove'"'"' in simulation, '"'"'existing upgrades or unexpected count'"'"'
for name in planned:
    matching = [line for key, line in rows.items() if key.split('"'"':'"'"')[0] == name]
    assert not matching, ('"'"'baseline already contains a proposed package'"'"', name, matching)
BASE.mkdir(mode=0o700)
(BASE / '"'"'preparation-before.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps({'"'"'packages'"'"': before, '"'"'manual_packages'"'"': manual_before, '"'"'simulation'"'"': simulation, '"'"'expected_added'"'"': sorted(EXPECTED)}, indent=2)+'"'"'\n'"'"')
with (BASE / '"'"'preparation-install.txt'"'"').open('"'"'w'"'"') as stream:
    subprocess.run(['"'"'sudo'"'"', '"'"'-n'"'"', '"'"'env'"'"', '"'"'DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive'"'"', '"'"'apt-get'"'"', '"'"'install'"'"', '"'"'-y'"'"', '"'"'--no-install-recommends'"'"', '"'"'--no-upgrade'"'"', '"'"'qemu-system-arm'"'"', '"'"'qemu-efi-aarch64'"'"', '"'"'qemu-utils'"'"'], stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=600)
after, new_rows = packages()
changed = [key for key, value in rows.items() if new_rows.get(key) != value]
added = {key.split('"'"':'"'"')[0] for key in set(new_rows)-set(rows)}
result = {'"'"'packages'"'"': after, '"'"'manual_packages'"'"': subprocess.check_output(['"'"'apt-mark'"'"', '"'"'showmanual'"'"'], text=True), '"'"'added'"'"': sorted(added), '"'"'changed_existing'"'"': changed, '"'"'before_sha256'"'"': hashlib.sha256(before.encode()).hexdigest(), '"'"'after_sha256'"'"': hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest()}
(BASE / '"'"'preparation-after.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'"'"'\n'"'"')
assert not changed and added == EXPECTED, result
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in result.items() if key not in ('"'"'packages'"'"', '"'"'manual_packages'"'"')}, indent=2))
print(subprocess.check_output(['"'"'qemu-system-aarch64'"'"', '"'"'--version'"'"'], text=True).splitlines()[0])
'

argv:
python3 -c 'import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import time
base = pathlib.Path.home() / '"'"'limeos-arm64-qual/image'"'"'
expected = '"'"'835b929522716de9798d1c0fbe61caae8313ab78858b278f3389a2db922ae42e4619b4a776ecad39583c149fb85334a2f8cdae685bc56987160e5c86a2354375'"'"'
lines = (base / '"'"'SHA512SUMS'"'"').read_text().splitlines()
matching = [line for line in lines if line.endswith('"'"'  debian-12-genericcloud-arm64.qcow2'"'"')]
assert len(matching) == 1 and matching[0].split()[0] == expected
with (base / '"'"'debian-12-genericcloud-arm64.qcow2'"'"').open('"'"'rb'"'"') as stream:
    actual = hashlib.file_digest(stream, '"'"'sha512'"'"').hexdigest()
assert actual == expected, actual
pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['"'"'systemctl'"'"', '"'"'show'"'"', '"'"'pi-health'"'"', '"'"'--property=MainPID'"'"', '"'"'--value'"'"'], text=True))
stat = pathlib.Path(f'"'"'/proc/{pid}/stat'"'"').read_text()
start = int(stat[stat.rindex('"'"')'"'"')+2:].split()[19])
assert subprocess.check_output(['"'"'systemctl'"'"', '"'"'is-active'"'"', '"'"'pi-health'"'"', '"'"'pihealth-helper'"'"', '"'"'docker'"'"'], text=True).splitlines() == ['"'"'active'"'"']*3
print(json.dumps({'"'"'captured_epoch'"'"': time.time(), '"'"'image_sha512'"'"': actual, '"'"'checksum_manifest_sha256'"'"': hashlib.sha256((base/'"'"'SHA512SUMS'"'"').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), '"'"'pi_health_identity'"'"': {'"'"'pid'"'"':pid,'"'"'start_ticks'"'"':start}, '"'"'no_existing_qemu'"'"': subprocess.run(['"'"'pgrep'"'"','"'"'-a'"'"','"'"'qemu'"'"'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout == '"'"''"'"'}, indent=2))
'

label: proof-detached-before
argv:
python3 -c '"""Read exact deadline owner/child identities and preserve an unrelated service."""
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import time
CONTROL = '"'"'/tmp/limeos-arm64-supervisor-PYDx8erm'"'"'
MARKER = '"'"'limeos-arm64-integrated-proof-20261012-95495f6306f353dd'"'"'

def read_control(name):
    return subprocess.check_output(['"'"'sudo'"'"','"'"'-n'"'"','"'"'cat'"'"',CONTROL+'"'"'/'"'"'+name], text=True)

def identity(pid):
    try:
        root = pathlib.Path('"'"'/proc'"'"')/str(pid)
        stat = (root/'"'"'stat'"'"').read_text()
        fields = stat[stat.rindex('"'"')'"'"')+2:].split()
        uid = int(next(line.split()[1] for line in (root/'"'"'status'"'"').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('"'"'Uid:'"'"')))
        return {'"'"'pid'"'"':pid, '"'"'state'"'"':fields[0], '"'"'parent_pid'"'"':int(fields[1]), '"'"'start_ticks'"'"':int(fields[19]), '"'"'uid'"'"':uid, '"'"'argv'"'"':[part.decode(errors='"'"'replace'"'"') for part in (root/'"'"'cmdline'"'"').read_bytes().split(b'"'"'\0'"'"') if part]}
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None

owner = json.loads(read_control('"'"'owner.json'"'"'))
child = json.loads(read_control('"'"'process.json'"'"'))
assert owner['"'"'marker'"'"'] == child['"'"'marker'"'"'] == MARKER
pid = int(subprocess.check_output(['"'"'systemctl'"'"','"'"'show'"'"','"'"'pi-health'"'"','"'"'--property=MainPID'"'"','"'"'--value'"'"'],text=True))
production = identity(pid)
assert production['"'"'pid'"'"'] == 2758 and production['"'"'start_ticks'"'"'] == 3029
result = {'"'"'captured_epoch'"'"':time.time(), '"'"'recorded_owner'"'"':owner,'"'"'recorded_child'"'"':child,'"'"'actual_owner'"'"':identity(owner['"'"'pid'"'"']),'"'"'actual_child'"'"':identity(child['"'"'pid'"'"']),'"'"'production_identity'"'"':production,'"'"'supervisor_log'"'"':[json.loads(line) for line in read_control('"'"'supervisor.log'"'"').splitlines()], '"'"'protected_hashes'"'"':subprocess.check_output(['"'"'sudo'"'"','"'"'-n'"'"','"'"'sha256sum'"'"',CONTROL+'"'"'/guest_supervisor.py'"'"',CONTROL+'"'"'/launch.json'"'"'],text=True)}
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
'

label: memory-after-guard
argv:
python3 -c '"""Passive memory/reclaim diagnosis after the guard stopped the owned guest."""
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import time
result = {'"'"'captured_utc'"'"':time.strftime('"'"'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'"'"',time.gmtime()), '"'"'meminfo'"'"':pathlib.Path('"'"'/proc/meminfo'"'"').read_text(), '"'"'vmstat'"'"':pathlib.Path('"'"'/proc/vmstat'"'"').read_text(), '"'"'swappiness'"'"':pathlib.Path('"'"'/proc/sys/vm/swappiness'"'"').read_text().strip(), '"'"'processes'"'"':[]}
for directory in pathlib.Path('"'"'/proc'"'"').iterdir():
    if not directory.name.isdigit():
        continue
    try:
        text = (directory/'"'"'status'"'"').read_text()
        fields = {line.split('"'"':'"'"',1)[0]:line.split('"'"':'"'"',1)[1].strip() for line in text.splitlines() if '"'"':'"'"' in line}
        rss = int(fields.get('"'"'VmRSS'"'"','"'"'0'"'"').split()[0])
        swap = int(fields.get('"'"'VmSwap'"'"','"'"'0'"'"').split()[0])
        if rss >= 32768 or swap >= 1024:
            stat = (directory/'"'"'stat'"'"').read_text()
            values = stat[stat.rindex('"'"')'"'"')+2:].split()
            result['"'"'processes'"'"'].append({'"'"'pid'"'"':int(directory.name),'"'"'name'"'"':fields['"'"'Name'"'"'],'"'"'rss_kib'"'"':rss,'"'"'swap_kib'"'"':swap,'"'"'major_faults'"'"':int(values[9]),'"'"'start_ticks'"'"':int(values[19])})
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
        pass
result['"'"'processes'"'"'].sort(key=lambda process:process['"'"'swap_kib'"'"'],reverse=True)
result['"'"'memory_pressure_available'"'"'] = pathlib.Path('"'"'/proc/pressure/memory'"'"').exists()
result['"'"'services'"'"'] = subprocess.check_output(['"'"'systemctl'"'"','"'"'show'"'"','"'"'pi-health'"'"','"'"'pihealth-helper'"'"','"'"'docker'"'"','"'"'smbd'"'"','"'"'--property=Id,ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,NRestarts'"'"'],text=True)
result['"'"'kernel_errors'"'"'] = subprocess.run(['"'"'sudo'"'"','"'"'-n'"'"','"'"'journalctl'"'"','"'"'-k'"'"','"'"'--since'"'"','"'"'2026-10-12 22:42:12 UTC'"'"','"'"'--no-pager'"'"','"'"'--grep'"'"','"'"'Out of memory|oom-kill|Killed process|I/O error|EXT4-fs error|under-voltage'"'"'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
'
